mapper.sql: o.outbox_id, o.topic, o.biz_key, (o.payload ->> 'poId')::bigint as po_id, (o.payload ->> 'claimId')::bigint as claim_id, coalesce(o.payload ->> 'poNo', o.payload ->> 'claimNo') as po_no, (o.payload ->> 'rev')::int as rev, o.payload ->> 'custNm' as cust_nm, o.payload ->> 'to' as to_addr, o.status, o.attempts, o.last_error, o.created_at, o.sent_at
mapper.select:
select from sys_outbox o
order by o.created_at desc, o.outbox_id desc limit 2000
